title: At a bar with a friend
goal: Order a drink and something to eat, ask your friend what they want, and pay at the end.
role: Your friend Pablo, meeting you at a bar in Madrid. Relaxed and friendly; uses tú.
openingEn: Hi! At last! So, what do you want to have?
focus: tú forms (quieres, tomas) and ordering with 'quiero' / 'me pones'

title: Checking into a hotel
goal: Give your name, say how many nights you are staying, and ask what time breakfast is.
role: The receptionist at a small hotel in Seville. Polite and patient; uses usted.
openingEn: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
focus: usted forms and polite requests with 'quería' / 'quisiera'
